title: Joel R. Poinsett to the Secretary of State, Buenos Aires reports 'part(s) in cipher', 10 May, 25 Jul, 30 Jul 1811 (HSP Poinsett Papers)

documents.shelfmark: Historical Society of Pennsylvania, Poinsett Papers (Gilpin collection), vol. 1 per the list heading (catalogue brief says vol. 4); list filmed in NARA M37 roll 2 frames 0020-0022
documents.route: Buenos Aires to Washington (Robert Smith, Secretary of State)

plaintext.source: Only the typed list of report summaries (NARA M37-02 0022) is seen; no decipherment or clear copy known.

transcription.notes: Nothing transcribed: the cipher passages themselves are not online. Only the list was read; it marks the three entries 'Part in cipher' / 'Parts in cipher'.

system.summary: unknown: the cipher passages have not been seen.
system.notes: symbol_kind and key_order are placeholders; nothing about the system is known.

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue task; then asked to close it as blocked on access.

solution.what: Two web searches (Poinsett 1811 despatch in cipher; Manning 1925 on copies returned to Poinsett 1818). No decipherment or edition found; Manning vol. 1 and HathiTrust full text not searched.

NARA record 213803757 lists 1058 digital objects; downloaded M37-02 frames 0019-0023 and read 0020-0022: the typed list marks the three entries as partly in cipher. Heading says bound in vol. 1, not vol. 4. No cipher groups on the film.
HSP vol. 1 not digitised that could be found; Department copies were returned to Poinsett in 1818 per the catalogue note. Closed as blocked on access.
